notify.add_id: LINE user or group ID (U… or C…)
notify.desc: Get a LINE message when a document has issues or cannot be read. The message contains only the file name and the names of the fields with problems.
notify.empty: No receivers yet. Add the first one below.
notify.guide.note: The Official Account ID that starts with @ is only for searching and adding friends. It cannot be used to send messages.
notify.guide.s1: Create a LINE Official Account (free) and turn on Messaging API in its settings.
notify.guide.s2: In the LINE Developers console open your channel, go to the Messaging API tab and press Issue next to Channel access token (long-lived). Paste it above.
notify.guide.s3: Each person who should receive alerts adds your Official Account as a friend. Without this LINE rejects the message.
notify.guide.s4: Find each person's User ID: on the Basic settings tab it is shown as Your user ID (for yourself). A group ID (starts with C) is received through the channel's webhook when someone writes in the group.
notify.guide.s5: Add each receiver with the Add button, send a test, then press Save for the token and message.
notify.guide.title: How to get the token and the receiver ID
